# mtncloud_load_balancer (Data Source)

Looks up one load balancer on an MTN Network by ID or by name, including one made in the console, with its listeners, and its pools with their members and health monitors. A name must match exactly one load balancer on the network. Each load balancer is read once per run, however many data sources ask about it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

# By name (matched exactly on the network); `id = "..."` works too.
data "mtncloud_load_balancer" "web" {
  network_id = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  name       = "web-lb"
}

output "web_listeners" {
  value = { for l in data.mtncloud_load_balancer.web.listeners : l.name => "${l.protocol}:${l.port}" }
}

output "web_backends" {
  value = flatten([for p in data.mtncloud_load_balancer.web.pools : [for m in p.members : "${m.address}:${m.port}"]])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The load balancer's ID. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) The load balancer's name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `can_manage` (Boolean) Whether your tenant owns the network, so it may change this load balancer.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `listeners` (Attributes List) Its listeners, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listeners))
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `pools` (Attributes List) Its pools, sorted by name, with their members and health monitors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `vip_address` (String) Private address it receives traffic on.
- `vip_port_id` (String) Port that holds the address; a public IP attaches to it.
- `vip_subnet` (String) That subnet's name and CIDR, for example `app (10.0.0.0/24)`.
- `vip_subnet_id` (String) Subnet of that address.

<a id="nestedatt--listeners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listeners`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) Addresses allowed to connect; empty allows any.
- `client_data_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds a client connection may stay idle.
- `connection_limit` (Number) Most connections at once; `-1` for no limit.
- `default_pool_id` (String) ID of the pool it sends traffic to, or empty.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `id` (String) Listener ID.
- `member_connect_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for a member to accept a connection.
- `member_data_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds a member connection may stay idle.
- `name` (String) Listener name.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `port` (Number) Port it listens on.
- `protocol` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `TERMINATED_HTTPS`, `TCP` or `UDP`.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `tcp_inspect_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for more data to inspect.
- `tls_certificate_ref` (String) Reference to the certificate a `TERMINATED_HTTPS` listener uses, or empty.


<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) How traffic is shared: `ROUND_ROBIN`, `LEAST_CONNECTIONS` or `SOURCE_IP`.
- `cookie_name` (String) Cookie used by `APP_COOKIE` persistence, or empty.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `health_monitor` (Attributes) The pool's health monitor, or null without one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--health_monitor))
- `id` (String) Pool ID.
- `listener_ids` (List of String) IDs of the listeners that use this pool.
- `members` (Attributes List) Backends, sorted by address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--members))
- `name` (String) Pool name.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to the members: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `PROXY`, `PROXYV2`, `TCP` or `UDP`.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `session_persistence` (String) `SOURCE_IP`, `HTTP_COOKIE` or `APP_COOKIE` to keep a client on one member, or empty.
- `tls_enabled` (Boolean) Whether connections to the members use TLS.

<a id="nestedatt--pools--health_monitor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.health_monitor`

Read-Only:

- `delay` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `expected_codes` (String) HTTP status codes that count as up, for example `200` or `200-204`, or empty.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method for `HTTP` and `HTTPS` checks, or empty.
- `id` (String) Health monitor ID.
- `max_retries` (Number) Successful checks in a row before a member is marked up.
- `max_retries_down` (Number) Failed checks in a row before a member is marked down.
- `name` (String) Health monitor name, or empty.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `pool_id` (String) ID of the pool it checks.
- `pool_name` (String) Name of the pool it checks.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds a check may take.
- `type` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `PING`, `TCP`, `TLS-HELLO` or `UDP-CONNECT`.
- `url_path` (String) Path requested by `HTTP` and `HTTPS` checks, or empty.


<a id="nestedatt--pools--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.members`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Backend IP address.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether it gets traffic only when every other member is down.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `id` (String) Member ID.
- `monitor_address` (String) Address the health monitor checks instead of `address`, or empty.
- `monitor_port` (Number) Port the health monitor checks instead of `port`, or 0.
- `name` (String) Member name, or empty.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `port` (Number) Backend port.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet the address is on, or empty for the load balancer's own.
- `weight` (Number) Share of traffic, 0 to 256; 0 sends it none.
